source_published_dataset.notes: User-provided byte-identical published Dryad file; do not store original data rows in GitHub

encryption: RSA-OAEP-SHA256 wraps 256bit random AES-GCM key; random nonce; compressed derived patch/year survey + network rows as ciphertext only; decrypted only in user's present ChatGPT sandbox; plaintext and ephemeral private key NEVER stored in GitHub

analysis_contract.key: exact integer patch ID plus calendar year, no fuzzy matching
analysis_contract.event_years: YearFrom=2007..2011 and YearTo=2008..2012 for uploaded 799 family-patch assignment rows
analysis_contract.primary_scope: 498 PatchFrom != PatchTo genetically inferred changes (families may have multiple destination rows); 301 same-patch resident assignments retained as separate category
analysis_contract.parent_survey_recorded_status: Schulz 2019 patch/year population >0 observed positive, ==0 recorded zero, missing/non-numeric unresolved
join_questions: For 799 assignments, how many (YearFrom,PatchFrom), (YearFrom,PatchTo), and (YearTo,PatchTo) actually have matched survey patch/year records?
How often was a genetically assigned source recorded positive, zero, or missing at YearFrom?
For off-patch assignments: number with recorded-zero target in YearFrom and positive target in YearTo (EOG eligible transitions); number resident/persistent/unknown
Distance consistency: compare published dispersalDistance (km) with Euclidean site-centroid km where both patched centroid coordinates are verified
Among matched EOG eligible transitions, evaluate whether the assigned source is in frozen previous-year observed-positive candidate set; no backward source inference from nearest alternative
Summarize source restriction and detection ambiguity by arrival year, not as causal effect or predictive superiority
assumptions: Genetic assignment originates from GENECLASS2 reference sampled source patches with score=100 per publication; uploaded data do not include score column so per-record confidence cannot be verified
Same fullsibfam ID may appear in two destination rows; use family-cluster counts not iid dispersal units
2019 source patch IDs presumed same system until exact identifier concordance shown
Genetically assigned movement between sampled patches not a direct observed flight or exact natal origin
This is historical same-archipelago, overlapping years exploratory evidence, not a fresh EOG-WF endpoint
stop_if: no temporal match for genetic movement assignments
analysis_contract.output: aggregate-only diagnostic JSON and no individual patch IDs, family IDs, coordinates or event rows

precision: do not compute p-values or claim validation of historical sources until independently corroborated and modeled assignment error
